findings.evidence: Line 59: "**An equivalence of representations is a `k`[G]`-linear isomorphism of the attached modules.**"; line 46 has the correct form "A `k[G]`-linear isomorphism".

findings.evidence: TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/CharacterTable/SimpleModuleCount.lean:51 `variable (k G : Type*) [Field k] [Group G] [Finite G] [IsSemisimpleRing k[G]]`; Completeness.lean:24 correctly says "over any field with `k[G]` semisimple".
findings.fix: Say "over any field whose group algebra is semisimple", matching the module docstring (line 24) and the lemma's own docstring.
findings.issue: The `spechtModuleClass_bijective` docstring states the cited bound without its hypothesis: "no field admits more isomorphism classes of simple modules over the group algebra than the group has conjugacy classes". `card_simpleSubmoduleClasses_le_card_conjClasses` is proved only under `[Finite G] [IsSemisimpleRing k[G]]`, so a reader citing it in modular characteristic would be citing something not available here.

summary: Module docstrings and declaration docstrings are present, accurate and match the statements in almost all cases; two defects: a malformed code span in a public docstring and a docstring sentence that states the counting bound without its semisimplicity hypothesis.
